script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

A dimly lit living room. A soft RAIN pelts the window. Two figures, JESSICA (early 30s, neurotic) and SAM (late 20s, cheerful), sit on the worn-out couch.

JESSICA
(looking worried)
Sam, I don't know if I can do this anymore.

SAM
(putting an arm around her)
Hey, you can. We can. You're not alone in this.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

They sit at a table near the window, sunlight filtering in. The clanging of mugs and chatter of other patrons fill the room.

JESSICA
(leaning in)
And what exactly is this, Sam?

SAM
(sipping coffee)
Just... helping you, Jess. I care about you, and I know things have been tough. But I believe in you.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

They wander through the gallery, eyes transfixed on the abstract art.

SAM
(points to a painting)
See this? It's like our friendship. Messy and complex, but beautiful in its own way.

JESSICA
(smiling)
I like that.

INT. JESSICA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jessica sits alone, staring at a blank canvas. A teary-eyed Sam enters, carrying a bag.

SAM
(setting the bag down)
I'm here, Jess. Let's create something together.

INT. ART STUDIO - DAY

They work together on a large canvas, their hands brushing against each other.

SAM
(smiling)
See? We're a team. And this is going to be our masterpiece.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

They sit at the same table, both engrossed in their sketchbooks.

JESSICA
(looking up)
We make a good team, Sam.

SAM
(grinning)
The best.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Their finished piece hangs on the wall, surrounded by admiring onlookers.

SAM
(proudly)
We did it, Jess.

JESSICA
(smiling)
Together.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jessica, now confident, paints in her apartment while humming to herself.

INT. ART STUDIO - DAY

Sam enters, a bouquet of flowers in hand.

SAM
(smiling)
You've come a long way, Jess.

JESSICA
(smiling back)
And I couldn't have done it without you.

They share a meaningful look.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

They sit at the same table, surrounded by the chatter of the bustling coffee shop.

JESSICA
(leaning in)
I've realized something, Sam.

SAM
(looking at her expectantly)
What's that?

JESSICA
(smiling)
We've created something beautiful together, but we've also healed each other.

SAM
(nodding)
I couldn't agree more.

They share a heartfelt smile, their friendship stronger than ever.

THE END.
